Subject: Reminder: Client Confidentiality Policy

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to remind everyone about the importance of maintaining strict confidentiality regarding our clients.

Recently, it was brought to my attention that Bob shared specific client details with his wife. While I trust each of you individually, this action is a direct violation of our company policy. Please ensure that all client information remains strictly confidential and is not discussed with anyone outside the authorized team.

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your continued professionalism.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
